description: For a repository that uses the metapatrol packages: extend it with "local>metapatrol/brand//renovate/metapatrol".

packageRules.description: One pull request for the @metapatrol packages: they are released together in one version, and @metapatrol/ng needs the @metapatrol/style of its own release (a peer dependency), so updated one by one, the lockfile of all but the first cannot be resolved.
